title: Compactness and Essential Norms of Weighted Bilinear Hardy Operators on General Intervals
summary: Let $I=(a,b)$ be an open interval with finite or infinite endpoints. For $1<p_1,p_2<\infty$ and $0<q<\infty$, we study the weighted bilinear Hardy operator $ \mathcal H_2(f,g)(x)=(\int_a^x f)(\int_a^x g) $ from $L^{p_1}(v_1;I)\times L^{p_2}(v_2;I)$ to $L^q(u;I)$, including the quasi-Banach target range $0<q<1$. With $\vartheta=\min\{1,q\}$, the target and bounded-bilinear-map spaces are treated through their complete powered metrics.
